newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 21.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe decides end of government framework for wages at public companies, says firms will negotiate wage ceilings individually.
-- Government-appointed mediator meets with unions today to try and defuse Credit Foncier crisis.
-- Eurotunnel bankers extend debt standstill to Dec 31, 1997.
